title: nmrForge: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: nmrForge automates Bruker multidimensional NMR processing with NMRPipe and SMILE, records parameters and quality-control decisions, and provides spectrum viewing and peak localization. Version 1.0.2 updates sampling identification, peak-axis and sign handling, conservative edge screening, reference filtering, reports and GUI interactions. The repository includes dated evidence from public BMRB timedomain entry 53374; those historical measurements are not a new validation of every 1.0.2 processing path.
